# Floom

> Floom is a native Rust UI library with fine-grained reactivity and great ergonomics, the "Floom 2.0" workspace. It is a self-drawn, retained-mode, GPU-accelerated GUI framework with no browser dependency. Edition 2024, MSRV 1.91, workspace version 0.2.0 (pre-1.0). Licensed MIT. The 1.0 definition is gated by budgets and conformance suites, not by copying competitor feature counts.

## Quick facts for an agent
- Crate map: `crates/{core,system,widgets,platform,render,native,devtools,app,frontend}`; the public facade is `crates/app/floom`
- API/ABI surface tests that must keep compiling live in `crates/app/floom/tests/` (`prelude_surface.rs`, `feature_graph.rs`, `docs_parity.rs`)
- Toolchain: `mise.toml` provisions rust 1.99.1; `rust-toolchain.toml` is the cargo-level pin. Run checks via the `just` recipes in `justfile` (e.g. `just gate`)
- Platform reality: only `aarch64-apple-darwin` is "tested"; the other 8 targets are device-/target-gated (see the release-policy targets table)
- TypeScript: `npm/@types/floom/index.d.ts` is the published TSX declaration surface.
